description: [Africa CDC] 26 October 2026; OSLO; -- CEPI's Research Preparedness Program, which aims to strengthen regional clinical trial readiness and emergency evidence generation, today announced up to US$8.2 million in additional funding to the Technical Coordinating Partners leading its West Africa component -- the International Vaccine Institute (IVI) and MRC Unit The Gambia at LSHTM (MRCG) -- to support implementation of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC)'s hub-and-spoke clinical trial model.

description: [Capital FM] Google announced the launch of its new Skilling Africa with Google website designed to expand access to digital and AI skills across the continent and help address the growing demand for AI-ready talent. description: [RFI] The third Russia-Africa Summit took place in Moscow this week, with 48 African nations sending delegations. It comes as Moscow grapples with sanctions and isolation over its Ukraine offensive, while African governments turn to it for security assistance. However, geopolitical analyst Priyal Singh tells RFI that despite this, Russia still lags behind China in its influence on the continent.
title: Africa: 'African Leaders Are Not Naive, They Will Partner With Whoever Makes the Best Offer'

description: [The Conversation Africa] The demand for donkey hides has grown exponentially over the past 15 years, driven mainly by demand from China. Lauren Johnston is a specialist on China trade with Africa. She has spent several years looking into the donkey trade, and has just published a book, China, Africa and the Market for Donkeys. She answers questions about what she found.
title: Africa: China Imports Millions of Donkey Hides From Africa Every Year - New Book Traces the Drivers and Impact
